page.notes: A blot covers part of the word "secundo" in the line "Aristoteles libro de Anima", so the reading is doubtful. "narura" for "naturam" appears to be a printing error, left as printed. The last word "formasse" is the catchword, printed at the right below the text. The dark mark at the left edge is a stain and was not transcribed.
